positive_terms: Disclosure of whether and how GHG emissions reduction targets and (or) any other targets have been set to manage material climate-related impacts, risks and opportunities

Disclosure of whether and how GHG emissions reduction targets and (or) any other targets have been set to manage material climate-related impacts, risks and opportunities。气候目标设定说明。以目标对象、目标年、基准年、排放范围和范围2方法区分事实；绝对减排、相对减排和强度目标不可互换。碳信用和移除不能直接替代毛排放减量。
